text: Figure 2.1: Example for a Communication Cluster within a physical network topology In the AUTOSAR methodology [3] the topology description is one of the inputs for the System Generator. It serves as constraints for mapping the Software Components (see chapter 4.1) contained in the RootSwCompositionPrototype as well as for deﬁning the System Communication matrix (see chapter 5). Gateways which allow the exchange of Signals between CommunicationClusters are covered in chapter 6.
